arguments.statement: ∀ k : ℤ, (ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (fun t : ℝ=>Complex.exp (Complex.I*(t*(k:ℝ)^3:ℝ)))) ∧ ∀ j t, iteratedDeriv j (fun t : ℝ=>Complex.exp (Complex.I*(t*(k:ℝ)^3:ℝ))) t=(Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)^j*Complex.exp (Complex.I*(t*(k:ℝ)^3:ℝ))
arguments.proof:
intro k
have hcast : ∀ t : ℝ, Complex.I*(t*(k:ℝ)^3:ℝ)=(Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)*(t:ℂ):=by intro t; push_cast; ring
simp_rw [hcast]
have hd : ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ=>Complex.exp ((Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)*(r:ℂ)))
  (Complex.exp ((Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)*(t:ℂ))*(Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)) t:=by
  intro t
  simpa using ((Complex.ofRealCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t (hasDerivAt_id t)).const_mul (Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)).cexp
constructor
· have hc : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (fun t : ℝ=>(t:ℂ)):=Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff
  exact (contDiff_const.mul hc).cexp
· intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => intro t; simp
  | succ j hj =>
    intro t
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
    have he : iteratedDeriv j (fun t : ℝ=>Complex.exp ((Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)*(t:ℂ))) =
      (fun t : ℝ=>(Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)^j*Complex.exp ((Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)*(t:ℂ))) := funext hj
    rw [he,((hd t).const_mul _).deriv,pow_succ]
    ring

helper.statement: ∀ k : ℤ, (ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (fun t : ℝ=>Complex.exp (Complex.I*(t*(k:ℝ)^3:ℝ)))) ∧ ∀ j t, iteratedDeriv j (fun t : ℝ=>Complex.exp (Complex.I*(t*(k:ℝ)^3:ℝ))) t=(Complex.I*(k:ℂ)^3)^j*Complex.exp (Complex.I*(t*(k:ℝ)^3:ℝ))

arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  dsimp only
  let Reg := fun f : Path => ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2,  ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u ∧ ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (u t) k=(k:ℂ)^n*f t k
  obtain ⟨ev,he,hsep⟩:=@yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have hh : ∀ f, Reg f → ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (fun t=>f t k):=by
    intro f hf k
    obtain ⟨u,hu,heq⟩:=hf 0
    have eqn : (fun t=>ev k (u t))=(fun t=>f t k):=by
      funext t
      rw [he,heq]
      simp
    rw [← eqn]
    exact (ev k).contDiff.comp hu
  refine ⟨hh,?_⟩
  intro f hf j n
  obtain ⟨u,hu,heq⟩:=hf n
  have hud : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (iteratedDeriv j u):=by
    induction j with
    | zero => exact hu
    | succ j hj => rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]; exact (contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.mp hj).2
  refine ⟨iteratedDeriv j u,hud,?_⟩
  intro t k
  rw [← he]
  rw [@yui_aux_0063 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ _ _ (ev k) u hu j t]
  have eqn : (fun r=>ev k (u r))=(fun r=>(k:ℂ)^n*f r k):=by
    funext r
    rw [he,heq]
  rw [eqn,iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field])

arguments.statement:
open KdVPlan in let Reg := fun f : Path => ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2,  ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u ∧ ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (u t) k=(k:ℂ)^n*f t k;
 ∀ f, Reg f → Reg (fun t=>S t (f t))
arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  dsimp only
  intro f hf n
  obtain ⟨ev,he,hsep⟩:=@yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  let φ : ℤ → ℝ → ℂ:=fun k t=>(k:ℂ)^n*S t (f t) k
  have hφ : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (φ k):=by
    intro k
    exact contDiff_const.mul ((@yui_aux_0065 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 k).1.mul
      ((@yui_aux_0066 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 f hf k))
  have hh : ∀ j i : ℕ, ∃ w : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2, Continuous w ∧
      ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (w t) k= S t (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)^(n+3*i)*iteratedDeriv (j-i) (fun r=>f r k) t) k:=by
    intro j i
    obtain ⟨u,hu,huE⟩:=(@yui_aux_0066 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2 f hf (j-i) (n+3*i)
    have huEq : ∀ t, FromLP 1 (u t)=(fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)^(n+3*i)*iteratedDeriv (j-i) (fun r=>f r k) t):=fun t=>funext (huE t)
    obtain ⟨w,hw,hwE⟩:=@yui_aux_0061 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ ⟨u,hu.continuous,huEq⟩
    exact ⟨w,hw,fun t k=>congrFun (hwE t) k⟩
  choose w hw hwE using hh
  let U : ℕ → ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2 :=
    fun j t=>∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j+1), ((j.choose i:ℂ)*Complex.I^i) • w j i t
  have hU : ∀ j, Continuous (U j):=by
    intro j
    exact continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i hi=>continuous_const.smul (hw j i))
  have hUE : ∀ j k t, ev k (U j t)=iteratedDeriv j (φ k) t:=by
    intro j k t
    change ev k (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j+1), ((j.choose i:ℂ)*Complex.I^i) • w j i t)=_
    simp only [map_sum]
    have hscalar : ∀ (c : ℂ) (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2), ev k (c • x)=c*ev k x:=by
      intro c x
      rw [he,(@yui_aux_0046 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2.1,he]
      rfl
    simp_rw [hscalar,he,hwE]
    change _ = iteratedDeriv j (fun r=>(k:ℂ)^n*(Complex.exp (Complex.I*(r*(k:ℝ)^3:ℝ))*f r k)) t
    rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field]
    rw [iteratedDeriv_mul
      ((@yui_aux_0065 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 k).1.of_le (le_of_lt (@yui_aux_0052 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 j))).contDiffAt
      (((@yui_aux_0066 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 f hf k).of_le (le_of_lt (@yui_aux_0052 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 j))).contDiffAt]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [(@yui_aux_0065 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 k).2]
    simp only [S,pow_add,mul_pow,pow_mul]
    ring
  have hUs : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (U 0):=
    @yui_aux_0053 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ _ _ _ ℤ ev hsep φ hφ U hU hUE
  refine ⟨U 0,hUs,?_⟩
  intro t k
  rw [← he,hUE]
  rfl)

arguments.statement:
open KdVPlan in let Reg := fun f : Path => ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2,  ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u ∧ ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (u t) k=(k:ℂ)^n*f t k;
 ∀ f, Reg f → Reg (fun t=>S t (f t))
arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  dsimp only
  intro f hf n
  obtain ⟨ev,he,hsep⟩:=@yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  let φ : ℤ → ℝ → ℂ:=fun k t=>(k:ℂ)^n*S t (f t) k
  have hφ : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (φ k):=by
    intro k
    exact contDiff_const.mul ((@yui_aux_0065 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 k).1.mul
      ((@yui_aux_0066 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 f hf k))
  have hh : ∀ j i : ℕ, ∃ w : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2, Continuous w ∧
      ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (w t) k= S t (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)^(n+3*i)*iteratedDeriv (j-i) (fun r=>f r k) t) k:=by
    intro j i
    obtain ⟨u,hu,huE⟩:=(@yui_aux_0066 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2 f hf (j-i) (n+3*i)
    have huEq : ∀ t, FromLP 1 (u t)=(fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)^(n+3*i)*iteratedDeriv (j-i) (fun r=>f r k) t):=fun t=>funext (huE t)
    obtain ⟨w,hw,hwE⟩:=@yui_aux_0061 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ ⟨u,hu.continuous,huEq⟩
    exact ⟨w,hw,fun t k=>congrFun (hwE t) k⟩
  choose w hw hwE using hh
  let U : ℕ → ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2 :=
    fun j t=>∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j+1), ((j.choose i:ℂ)*Complex.I^i) • w j i t
  have hU : ∀ j, Continuous (U j):=by
    intro j
    exact continuous_finset_sum _ (fun i hi=>(continuous_const : Continuous (fun _ : ℝ=>((j.choose i:ℂ)*Complex.I^i))).smul (hw j i))
  have hUE : ∀ j k t, ev k (U j t)=iteratedDeriv j (φ k) t:=by
    intro j k t
    change ev k (∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j+1), ((j.choose i:ℂ)*Complex.I^i) • w j i t)=_
    simp only [map_sum]
    have hscalar : ∀ (c : ℂ) (x : lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2), ev k (c • x)=c*ev k x:=by
      intro c x
      rw [he,(@yui_aux_0046 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2.1,he]
      rfl
    simp_rw [hscalar,he,hwE]
    change _ = iteratedDeriv j (fun r=>(k:ℂ)^n*(Complex.exp (Complex.I*(r*(k:ℝ)^3:ℝ))*f r k)) t
    rw [iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field]

arguments.statement:
∀ (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E],
 ∀ (u : ℝ → E), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u → ∀ a : ℝ,
 ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (fun t=>∫ r in a..t, u r)
arguments.proof:
intro E _ _ _ u hu a
have hd : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun t=>∫ r in a..t, u r) (u t) t:=by
  intro t
  exact intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hu.continuous.intervalIntegrable _ _)
    (hu.continuous.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter _ _) hu.continuous.continuousAt
apply contDiff_infty_iff_deriv.mpr
refine ⟨fun t=>(hd t).differentiableAt,?_⟩
have he : deriv (fun t=>∫ r in a..t, u r)=u:=funext (fun t=>(hd t).deriv)
rw [he]
exact hu

open KdVPlan in let Reg := fun f : Path => ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2,  ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u ∧ ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (u t) k=(k:ℂ)^n*f t k;
 (∀ f g, Reg f → Reg g → Reg (fun t=>mul (f t) (g t))) ∧
 (∀ f, Reg f → Reg (fun t=>f (-t))) ∧
 (∀ M : ℤ → ℂ, (∃ C : ℝ, 0≤C ∧ ∀ k, ‖M k‖≤C) →
   ∀ f, Reg f → Reg (fun t k=>M k*f t k))
arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  dsimp only
  let Reg := fun f : Path => ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2,  ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u ∧ ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (u t) k=(k:ℂ)^n*f t k
  have basic:=@yui_aux_0064 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  obtain ⟨B,hB⟩:=@yui_aux_0060 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have hh : ∀ n f g, Reg f → Reg g →
      ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u ∧
        ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (u t) k=(k:ℂ)^n*mul (f t) (g t) k:=by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro f g hf hg
      obtain ⟨u,hu,he⟩:=hf 0
      obtain ⟨v,hv,hvE⟩:=hg 0
      refine ⟨fun t=>B (u t) (v t),(B.contDiff.comp hu).clm_apply hv,?_⟩
      intro t k
      have huf : FromLP 1 (u t)=f t:=by funext k; simpa using he t k
      have hvf : FromLP 1 (v t)=g t:=by funext k; simpa using hvE t k
      rw [hB,huf,hvf]
      simp
    | succ n ih =>
      intro f g hf hg
      obtain ⟨u,hu,he⟩:=ih _ g (basic.2.2.2.1 f hf) hg
      obtain ⟨v,hv,hvE⟩:=ih f _ hf (basic.2.2.2.1 g hg)
      refine ⟨fun t=>u t+v t,hu.add hv,?_⟩
      intro t k
      rw [( @yui_aux_0046 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.1 1 _ _ |>.1]
      change FromLP 1 (u t) k+FromLP 1 (v t) k=_
      rw [he,hvE,← mul_add]
      have hleib:=congrFun (@yui_aux_0041 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ _ (basic.2.2.2.2 f hf t) (basic.2.2.2.2 g hg t)) k
      change (k:ℂ)*mul (f t) (g t) k=mul (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f t k) (g t) k+mul (f t) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*g t k) k at hleib
      rw [← hleib,pow_succ]
      ring
  refine ⟨fun f g hf hg n=>hh n f g hf hg,?_,?_⟩
  · intro f hf n
    obtain ⟨u,hu,he⟩:=hf n
    exact ⟨fun t=>u (-t),hu.comp contDiff_neg,fun t k=>he (-t) k⟩
  · intro M hM f hf n
    obtain ⟨C,hC,hCM⟩:=hM
    obtain ⟨A,hA⟩:=@yui_aux_0062 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 M C hC hCM
    obtain ⟨u,hu,he⟩:=hf n
    refine ⟨fun t=>A (u t), (A.restrictScalars ℝ).contDiff.comp hu,?_⟩
    intro t k
    rw [hA,he]
    ring)

arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  dsimp only
  intro f hf a n
  obtain ⟨u,hu,huE⟩:=hf n
  obtain ⟨ev,he,hsep⟩:=@yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013

  change (∫ r in a..t,(k:ℂ)^n*f r k)=(k:ℂ)^n*∫ r in a..t,f r k

arguments.statement:
open KdVPlan in let Reg := fun f : Path => ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2,  ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u ∧ ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (u t) k=(k:ℂ)^n*f t k;
 (∀ f g, Reg f → Reg g → Reg (fun t=>B t (f t) (g t))) ∧
 (∀ a f, Smooth f → Reg (F a f) ∧ Reg (Cst a f) ∧ Reg (Qst a f)) ∧
 (∀ τ : ℝ, 0<τ → ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ f : Coeff, Data 0 f → Smooth f →
   Reg (Vst ((n:ℝ)*τ) τ f))
arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  dsimp only
  let Reg := fun f : Path => ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2,  ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u ∧ ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (u t) k=(k:ℂ)^n*f t k
  have basic:=@yui_aux_0064 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have ops:=@yui_aux_0069 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have hs :=@yui_aux_0067 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have hi :=@yui_aux_0070 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have hminus : ∀ f, Reg f → Reg (fun t=>S (-t) (f t)):=by
    intro f hf
    have hh:=ops.2.1 _ (hs _ (ops.2.1 f hf))
    simpa only [neg_neg] using hh
  have hB : ∀ f g, Reg f → Reg g → Reg (fun t=>B t (f t) (g t)):=by
    intro f g hf hg
    have hp:=ops.1 _ _ (hs f hf) (hs g hg)
    have hd:=basic.2.2.1 (fun _=>Complex.I) contDiff_const _ (basic.2.2.2.1 _ hp)
    exact hminus _ hd
  have hstage : ∀ a f, Smooth f → Reg (F a f) ∧ Reg (Cst a f) ∧ Reg (Qst a f):=by
    intro a f hf
    have hc:=basic.1 f hf
    have hF :=basic.2.2.1 (fun _=>(1/2:ℂ)) contDiff_const _ (hi _ (hB _ _ hc hc) a)
    refine ⟨hF,hi _ (hB _ _ hc hF) a,?_⟩
    exact basic.2.2.1 (fun _=>(1/2:ℂ)) contDiff_const _ (hi _ (hB _ _ hF hF) a)
  refine ⟨hB,hstage,?_⟩
  intro τ hτ n f hf hfs
  let a : ℝ:=(n:ℝ)*τ
  let b : ℝ:=((n:ℝ)+1)*τ
  have hc:=basic.1 f hfs
  obtain ⟨hF,hC,hQ⟩:=hstage a f hfs
  have hrem : rem a τ f f f=f+F a f b+Cst a f b-S (-((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (psi τ (S a f)):=by
    have hh:=h_E006 τ hτ n f hf hfs
    change S (-((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (psi τ (S a f))=f+F a f b+Cst a f b-rem a τ f f f at hh
    calc
      rem a τ f f f = (f+F a f b+Cst a f b)-(f+F a f b+Cst a f b-rem a τ f f f):=by abel
      _ = _ :=by rw [← hh]
  have hu : Smooth (S (-((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (psi τ (S a f))):=by
    apply (@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.1
    apply (@yui_aux_0044 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 _ _ |>.2.2
    exact (@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.1 a f hfs
  have hW : Smooth (Wst a τ f):=by
    have hsmooth := (@yui_aux_0043 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2.2
    have hb : a+τ=b:=by dsimp [a,b]; ring
    unfold Wst
    rw [hrem]
    exact (hsmooth _ _ (basic.2.2.2.2 _ hQ (a+τ))
      ((hsmooth _ _ ((hsmooth _ _ hfs (basic.2.2.2.2 _ hF b)).1) (basic.2.2.2.2 _ hC b)).1 |>
        fun hh=>(hsmooth _ _ hh hu).2)).1
  have hscalar : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (fun t : ℝ=>(((t-a)/τ:ℝ):ℂ)):=by
    apply Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp
    fun_prop
  have hcorr:=basic.2.2.1 _ hscalar _ (basic.1 _ hW)
  exact (basic.2.1 _ _ ((basic.2.1 _ _ ((basic.2.1 _ _ hc hF).1) hC).1) hQ).1 |>
    fun hv=>(basic.2.1 _ _ hv hcorr).2)

open KdVPlan in let Reg := fun f : Path => ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2,  ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u ∧ ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (u t) k=(k:ℂ)^n*f t k;
 (∀ f g, Reg f → Reg g → Reg (fun t=>B t (f t) (g t))) ∧
 (∀ a f, Smooth f → Reg (F a f) ∧ Reg (Cst a f) ∧ Reg (Qst a f)) ∧
 (∀ τ : ℝ, 0<τ → ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ f : Coeff, Data 0 f → Smooth f →
   Reg (Vst ((n:ℝ)*τ) τ f))
arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  dsimp only
  let Reg := fun f : Path => ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2,  ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u ∧ ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (u t) k=(k:ℂ)^n*f t k
  have basic:=@yui_aux_0064 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have ops:=@yui_aux_0069 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have hs :=@yui_aux_0067 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have hi :=@yui_aux_0070 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have hminus : ∀ f, Reg f → Reg (fun t=>S (-t) (f t)):=by
    intro f hf
    have hh:=ops.2.1 _ (hs _ (ops.2.1 f hf))
    simpa only [neg_neg] using hh
  have hB : ∀ f g, Reg f → Reg g → Reg (fun t=>B t (f t) (g t)):=by
    intro f g hf hg
    have hp:=ops.1 _ _ (hs f hf) (hs g hg)
    have hd:=basic.2.2.1 (fun _=>Complex.I) contDiff_const _ (basic.2.2.2.1 _ hp)
    apply hminus
    simpa only [dx,scale,mul_assoc] using hd
  have hstage : ∀ a f, Smooth f → Reg (F a f) ∧ Reg (Cst a f) ∧ Reg (Qst a f):=by
    intro a f hf
    have hc:=basic.1 f hf
    have hF :=basic.2.2.1 (fun _=>(1/2:ℂ)) contDiff_const _ (hi _ (hB _ _ hc hc) a)
    refine ⟨hF,hi _ (hB _ _ hc hF) a,?_⟩
    exact basic.2.2.1 (fun _=>(1/2:ℂ)) contDiff_const _ (hi _ (hB _ _ hF hF) a)
  refine ⟨hB,hstage,?_⟩
  intro τ hτ n f hf hfs
  let a : ℝ:=(n:ℝ)*τ
  let b : ℝ:=((n:ℝ)+1)*τ
  have hc:=basic.1 f hfs
  obtain ⟨hF,hC,hQ⟩:=hstage a f hfs
  have hrem : rem a τ f f f=f+F a f b+Cst a f b-S (-((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (psi τ (S a f)):=by
    have hh:=h_E006 τ hτ n f hf hfs
    change S (-((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (psi τ (S a f))=f+F a f b+Cst a f b-rem a τ f f f at hh
    calc
      rem a τ f f f = (f+F a f b+Cst a f b)-(f+F a f b+Cst a f b-rem a τ f f f):=by abel
      _ = _ :=by rw [← hh]
  have hu : Smooth (S (-((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (psi τ (S a f))):=by
    apply (@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.1
    exact ((@yui_aux_0044 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 τ _ ((@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.1 a f hfs)).2.2
  have hW : Smooth (Wst a τ f):=by
    have hsmooth := (@yui_aux_0043 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2.2
    have hb : a+τ=b:=by dsimp [a,b]; ring
    unfold Wst
    rw [hrem]
    exact (hsmooth _ _ (basic.2.2.2.2 _ hQ (a+τ))
      ((hsmooth _ _ ((hsmooth _ _ hfs (basic.2.2.2.2 _ hF b)).1) (basic.2.2.2.2 _ hC b)).1 |>
        fun hh=>(hsmooth _ _ hh hu).2)).1
  have hscalar : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (fun t : ℝ=>(((t-a)/τ:ℝ):ℂ)):=by
    apply Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).mul contDiff_const
  have hcorr:=basic.2.2.1 _ hscalar _ (basic.1 _ hW)
  exact (basic.2.1 _ _ ((basic.2.1 _ _ ((basic.2.1 _ _ hc hF).1) hC).1) hQ).1 |>
    fun hv=>(basic.2.1 _ _ hv hcorr).2)

    have hw : ∀ k : ℤ, 0≤weight (m:ℝ) k := fun k=>Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _

open KdVPlan in let Reg := fun f : Path => ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2,  ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u ∧ ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (u t) k=(k:ℂ)^n*f t k;
 (∀ f g, Reg f → Reg g → Reg (fun t=>B t (f t) (g t))) ∧
 (∀ a f, Smooth f → Reg (F a f) ∧ Reg (Cst a f) ∧ Reg (Qst a f)) ∧
 (∀ τ : ℝ, 0<τ → ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ f : Coeff, Data 0 f → Smooth f →
   Reg (Vst ((n:ℝ)*τ) τ f))
arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  dsimp only
  let Reg := fun f : Path => ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2,  ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u ∧ ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (u t) k=(k:ℂ)^n*f t k
  have basic:=@yui_aux_0064 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have ops:=@yui_aux_0069 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have hs :=@yui_aux_0067 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have hi :=@yui_aux_0070 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have hminus : ∀ f, Reg f → Reg (fun t=>S (-t) (f t)):=by
    intro f hf
    have hh:=ops.2.1 _ (hs _ (ops.2.1 f hf))
    simpa only [neg_neg] using hh
  have hB : ∀ f g, Reg f → Reg g → Reg (fun t=>B t (f t) (g t)):=by
    intro f g hf hg
    have hp:=ops.1 _ _ (hs f hf) (hs g hg)
    have hd:=basic.2.2.1 (fun _=>Complex.I) contDiff_const _ (basic.2.2.2.1 _ hp)
    apply hminus
    simpa only [Reg,dx,scale,mul_assoc] using hd
  have hstage : ∀ a f, Smooth f → Reg (F a f) ∧ Reg (Cst a f) ∧ Reg (Qst a f):=by
    intro a f hf
    have hc:=basic.1 f hf
    have hF :=basic.2.2.1 (fun _=>(1/2:ℂ)) contDiff_const _ (hi _ (hB _ _ hc hc) a)
    refine ⟨hF,hi _ (hB _ _ hc hF) a,?_⟩
    exact basic.2.2.1 (fun _=>(1/2:ℂ)) contDiff_const _ (hi _ (hB _ _ hF hF) a)
  refine ⟨hB,hstage,?_⟩
  intro τ hτ n f hf hfs
  let a : ℝ:=(n:ℝ)*τ
  let b : ℝ:=((n:ℝ)+1)*τ
  have hc:=basic.1 f hfs
  obtain ⟨hF,hC,hQ⟩:=hstage a f hfs
  have hrem : rem a τ f f f=f+F a f b+Cst a f b-S (-((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (psi τ (S a f)):=by
    have hh:=h_E006 τ hτ n f hf hfs
    change S (-((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (psi τ (S a f))=f+F a f b+Cst a f b-rem a τ f f f at hh
    calc
      rem a τ f f f = (f+F a f b+Cst a f b)-(f+F a f b+Cst a f b-rem a τ f f f):=by abel
      _ = _ :=by rw [← hh]
  have hu : Smooth (S (-((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (psi τ (S a f))):=by
    apply (@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.1
    exact ((@yui_aux_0044 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 τ _ ((@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.1 a f hfs)).2.2
  have hW : Smooth (Wst a τ f):=by
    have hsmooth := (@yui_aux_0043 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2.2
    have hb : a+τ=b:=by dsimp [a,b]; ring
    unfold Wst
    rw [hrem]
    exact (hsmooth _ _ (basic.2.2.2.2 _ hQ (a+τ))
      ((hsmooth _ _ ((hsmooth _ _ hfs (basic.2.2.2.2 _ hF b)).1) (basic.2.2.2.2 _ hC b)).1 |>
        fun hh=>(hsmooth _ _ hh hu).2)).1
  have hscalar : ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (fun t : ℝ=>(((t-a)/τ:ℝ):ℂ)):=by
    apply Complex.ofRealCLM.contDiff.comp
    change ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) (fun t : ℝ=>(t-a)*τ⁻¹)
    exact (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const).mul contDiff_const
  have hcorr:=basic.2.2.1 _ hscalar _ (basic.1 _ hW)
  exact (basic.2.1 _ _ ((basic.2.1 _ _ ((basic.2.1 _ _ hc hF).1) hC).1) hQ).1 |>
    fun hv=>(basic.2.1 _ _ hv hcorr).2)

exact (open KdVPlan in by
  intro m f hf hd
  refine ⟨(@yui_aux_0038 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 m f).mp ⟨hf,hd⟩,?_⟩
  have he : (fun k : ℤ=>weight ((m:ℝ)+1) k*‖f k‖^2)=(fun k : ℤ=>weight (m:ℝ) k*‖f k‖^2)+(fun k : ℤ=>weight (m:ℝ) k*‖(k:ℂ)*f k‖^2) := by
    funext k
    simp only [weight,Real.rpow_add (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<1+(k:ℝ)^2),Real.rpow_one,norm_mul,mul_pow,Pi.add_apply]
    have hn : ‖(k:ℂ)‖^2=(k:ℝ)^2 := by simp [Complex.norm_intCast,sq_abs]
    rw [hn]

  have hs : ∀ (s : ℝ) (g : Coeff), (hn s g)^2=∑' k, weight s k*‖g k‖^2:=by
    intro s g
    exact @yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ (fun k=>mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _) (sq_nonneg _))
  have heq : (hn ((m:ℝ)+1) f)^2=(hn (m:ℝ) f)^2+(hn (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k))^2:=by
    rw [hs,hs,hs,he,tsum_add hf hd]
  have h1:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).1 f
  have h2:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).1 (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k)
  have h3:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 ((m:ℝ)+1)).1 f
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg h1 h2])

open KdVPlan in ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ f : Coeff,
 MemH (m:ℝ) f → MemH (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k) →
 HB ((m:ℝ)+1) f (hn (m:ℝ) f+hn (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k))
arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  intro m f hf hd
  refine ⟨(@yui_aux_0038 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 m f).mp ⟨hf,hd⟩,?_⟩
  have he : (fun k : ℤ=>weight ((m:ℝ)+1) k*‖f k‖^2)=(fun k : ℤ=>weight (m:ℝ) k*‖f k‖^2)+(fun k : ℤ=>weight (m:ℝ) k*‖(k:ℂ)*f k‖^2) := by
    funext k
    simp only [weight,Real.rpow_add (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<1+(k:ℝ)^2),Real.rpow_one,norm_mul,mul_pow,Pi.add_apply]
    have hn : ‖(k:ℂ)‖^2=(k:ℝ)^2 := by simp [Complex.norm_intCast,sq_abs]
    rw [hn]
    ring
  have hs : ∀ (s : ℝ) (g : Coeff), (hn s g)^2=∑' k, weight s k*‖g k‖^2:=by
    intro s g
    exact @yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ (fun k=>mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _) (sq_nonneg _))
  have heq : (hn ((m:ℝ)+1) f)^2=(hn (m:ℝ) f)^2+(hn (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k))^2:=by
    rw [hs,hs,hs,he,hf.tsum_add hd]
  have h1:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).1 f
  have h2:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).1 (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k)
  have h3:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 ((m:ℝ)+1)).1 f
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg h1 h2])

open KdVPlan in ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ f : Coeff,
 MemH (m:ℝ) f → MemH (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k) →
 HB ((m:ℝ)+1) f (hn (m:ℝ) f+hn (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k))
arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  intro m f hf hd
  refine ⟨(@yui_aux_0038 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 m f).mp ⟨hf,hd⟩,?_⟩
  have he : (fun k : ℤ=>weight ((m:ℝ)+1) k*‖f k‖^2)=(fun k : ℤ=>weight (m:ℝ) k*‖f k‖^2)+(fun k : ℤ=>weight (m:ℝ) k*‖(k:ℂ)*f k‖^2) := by
    funext k
    simp only [weight,Real.rpow_add (by positivity : (0:ℝ)<1+(k:ℝ)^2),Real.rpow_one,norm_mul,mul_pow,Pi.add_apply]
    have hn : ‖(k:ℂ)‖^2=(k:ℝ)^2 := by simp [Complex.norm_intCast,sq_abs]
    rw [hn]
    ring
  have hs : ∀ (s : ℝ) (g : Coeff), (hn s g)^2=∑' k, weight s k*‖g k‖^2:=by
    intro s g
    exact @yui_aux_0005 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ (fun k=>mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (by positivity) _) (sq_nonneg _))
  have heq : (hn ((m:ℝ)+1) f)^2=(hn (m:ℝ) f)^2+(hn (m:ℝ) (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k))^2:=by
    rw [hs,hs,hs,he]
    exact hf.tsum_add hd
  have h1:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).1 f
  have h2:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).1 (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f k)
  have h3:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 ((m:ℝ)+1)).1 f
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg h1 h2])

exact (open KdVPlan in by
  constructor
  · intro s a c b hac hcb f hf hg
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      by_cases htc : t≤c
      · exact hf.1 t ⟨ht.1,htc⟩
      · exact hg.1 t ⟨le_of_not_ge htc,ht.2⟩
    · intro t ht ε hε
      rcases lt_trichotomy t c with htc|htc|htc
      · obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩:=hf.2 t ⟨ht.1,htc.le⟩ ε hε
        refine ⟨min δ (c-t),lt_min hδ (sub_pos.mpr htc),?_⟩
        intro r hr hdr
        have hh: r<c:=by
          have := (abs_lt.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hdr (min_le_right _ _))).2
          linarith
        exact hd r ⟨hr.1,hh.le⟩ (lt_of_lt_of_le hdr (min_le_left _ _))
      · subst t
        obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩:=hf.2 c ⟨hac,le_rfl⟩ ε hε
        obtain ⟨η,hη,he⟩:=hg.2 c ⟨le_rfl,hcb⟩ ε hε
        refine ⟨min δ η,lt_min hδ hη,?_⟩
        intro r hr hdr
        by_cases hrc : r≤c
        · exact hd r ⟨hr.1,hrc⟩ (lt_of_lt_of_le hdr (min_le_left _ _))
        · exact he r ⟨le_of_not_ge hrc,hr.2⟩ (lt_of_lt_of_le hdr (min_le_right _ _))
      · obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩:=hg.2 t ⟨htc.le,ht.2⟩ ε hε
        refine ⟨min δ (t-c),lt_min hδ (sub_pos.mpr htc),?_⟩
        intro r hr hdr
        have hh : c<r:=by
          have := (abs_lt.mp (lt_of_lt_of_le hdr (min_le_right _ _))).1
          linarith
        exact hd r ⟨hh.le,hr.2⟩ (lt_of_lt_of_le hdr (min_le_left _ _))
  · intro a b f g hf he
    refine ⟨fun k=>(hf.1 k).congr (fun t ht=>congrFun (he t ht) k),?_⟩
    intro m j
    apply @yui_aux_0073 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ _ _ _ _ (hf.2 m j)
    intro t ht
    funext k
    exact iteratedDerivWithin_congr (fun r hr=>congrFun (he r hr) k) ht)

arguments.statement:
open KdVPlan in ∀ τ : ℝ, 0<τ → ∀ f : Coeff, Data 0 f → Smooth f →
 (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ Icc ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ),
  interp τ f t=Vst ((n:ℝ)*τ) τ (twistedNum τ f n) t) ∧
 ∀ L : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, ContH (m:ℝ) 0 ((L:ℝ)*τ) (interp τ f)
arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  intro τ hτ f hf hfs
  have heq : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ Icc ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ),
      interp τ f t=Vst ((n:ℝ)*τ) τ (twistedNum τ f n) t:=by
    intro n t ht
    by_cases he : t=((n:ℝ)+1)*τ
    · subst t
      rw [← Nat.cast_one (R:=ℝ),← Nat.cast_add,(@yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.1 τ hτ]
      exact ((@yui_aux_0045 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 τ f n hτ hf hfs).2).symm
    · have ht0 : 0≤t:=le_trans (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) hτ.le) ht.1
      have hi : gridIndex τ t=n:=by
        apply (Nat.floor_eq_iff (div_nonneg ht0 hτ.le)).mpr
        exact ⟨(le_div_iff₀ hτ).mpr ht.1,(div_lt_iff₀ hτ).mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne ht.2 he)⟩
      simp only [interp,hi]
  have hc : ∀ n m : ℕ, ContH (m:ℝ) ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (interp τ f):=by
    intro n m
    have hd:=(@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2.2 τ f hf n |>.2
    have hs:=(@yui_aux_0044 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2 τ f hfs n |>.2
    have hreg:=(@yui_aux_0071 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2 τ hτ n _ hd hs
    exact @yui_aux_0073 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ _ _ _ _
      ((@yui_aux_0074 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 _ hreg m _ _) (heq n)
  refine ⟨heq,?_⟩
  intro L
  induction L with
  | zero =>
    intro m
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      have he : t=0:=by simpa using le_antisymm ht.2 ht.1
      subst t
      have hh:=(hc 0 m).1 0 (by simp; exact hτ.le)
      simpa using hh
    · intro t ht ε hε
      refine ⟨1,by norm_num,?_⟩
      intro r hr hdr
      have ht0 : t=0:=by simpa using le_antisymm ht.2 ht.1
      have hr0 : r=0:=by simpa using le_antisymm hr.2 hr.1
      rw [ht0,hr0,sub_self,(@yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _).2]
      exact hε
  | succ L ih =>
    intro m
    have hh:=(hc L m)
    have h := (@yui_aux_0075 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 (m:ℝ) 0 ((L:ℝ)*τ) (((L:ℝ)+1)*τ)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg L) hτ.le) (by nlinarith) _ (ih m) hh
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using h)

arguments.statement:
open KdVPlan in ∀ τ : ℝ, 0<τ → ∀ f : Coeff, Data 0 f → Smooth f →
 (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ Icc ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ),
  interp τ f t=Vst ((n:ℝ)*τ) τ (twistedNum τ f n) t) ∧
 ∀ L : ℕ, ∀ m : ℕ, ContH (m:ℝ) 0 ((L:ℝ)*τ) (interp τ f)
arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  intro τ hτ f hf hfs
  have heq : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ Icc ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ),
      interp τ f t=Vst ((n:ℝ)*τ) τ (twistedNum τ f n) t:=by
    intro n t ht
    by_cases he : t=((n:ℝ)+1)*τ
    · subst t
      rw [← Nat.cast_one (R:=ℝ),← Nat.cast_add,(@yui_aux_0011 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.1 τ hτ]
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using ((@yui_aux_0045 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 τ f n hτ hf hfs).2).symm
    · have ht0 : 0≤t:=le_trans (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg n) hτ.le) ht.1
      have hi : gridIndex τ t=n:=by
        apply (Nat.floor_eq_iff (div_nonneg ht0 hτ.le)).mpr
        exact ⟨(le_div_iff₀ hτ).mpr ht.1,(div_lt_iff₀ hτ).mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne ht.2 he)⟩
      simp only [interp,hi]
  have hc : ∀ n m : ℕ, ContH (m:ℝ) ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ) (interp τ f):=by
    intro n m
    have hd:=(@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2.2 τ f hf n |>.2
    have hs:=(@yui_aux_0044 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2 τ f hfs n |>.2
    have hreg:=(@yui_aux_0071 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2 τ hτ n _ hd hs
    exact @yui_aux_0073 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ _ _ _ _
      ((@yui_aux_0074 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 _ hreg m _ _) (heq n)
  refine ⟨heq,?_⟩
  intro L
  induction L with
  | zero =>
    intro m
    simp only [Nat.cast_zero,zero_mul]
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · intro t ht
      have he : t=0:=by simpa using le_antisymm ht.2 ht.1
      subst t
      have hh:=(hc 0 m).1 0 (by simp; exact hτ.le)
      simpa using hh
    · intro t ht ε hε
      refine ⟨1,by norm_num,?_⟩
      intro r hr hdr
      have ht0 : t=0:=by simpa using le_antisymm ht.2 ht.1
      have hr0 : r=0:=by simpa using le_antisymm hr.2 hr.1
      rw [ht0,hr0,sub_self,(@yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _).2]
      exact hε
  | succ L ih =>
    intro m
    have hh:=(hc L m)
    have h := (@yui_aux_0075 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 (m:ℝ) 0 ((L:ℝ)*τ) (((L:ℝ)+1)*τ)
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg L) hτ.le) (by nlinarith) _ (ih m) hh
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using h)

open KdVPlan in ∀ τ : ℝ, 0<τ → ∀ f : Coeff, Data 0 f → Smooth f →
 (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ t ∈ Icc ((n:ℝ)*τ) (((n:ℝ)+1)*τ),

arguments.statement:
open KdVPlan in ∀ τ : ℝ, 0<τ → ∀ f : Coeff, Data 0 f → Smooth f →
 ∀ L : ℕ, Piecewise 0 ((L:ℝ)*τ) (interp τ f)
arguments.proof:
exact (open KdVPlan in by
  intro τ hτ f hf hfs L
  obtain ⟨heq,hcont⟩:=@yui_aux_0076 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 τ hτ f hf hfs
  refine ⟨hcont L,Finset.image (fun n : ℕ=>(n:ℝ)*τ) (Finset.range (L+1)),?_⟩
  intro l r hl hlr hr hp
  let n : ℕ:=gridIndex τ l
  have hflo : (n:ℝ)≤l/τ ∧ l/τ<(n:ℝ)+1 :=
    (Nat.floor_eq_iff (div_nonneg hl hτ.le)).mp rfl
  have hnl : (n:ℝ)*τ≤l:=(le_div_iff₀ hτ).mp hflo.1
  have hln : l<((n:ℝ)+1)*τ:=(div_lt_iff₀ hτ).mp hflo.2
  have hnL : n<L:=by
    have hh : (n:ℝ)<(L:ℝ):=by nlinarith
    exact_mod_cast hh
  have hrn : r≤((n:ℝ)+1)*τ:=by
    by_contra! hh
    have hmem : ((n:ℝ)+1)*τ∈Finset.image (fun n : ℕ=>(n:ℝ)*τ) (Finset.range (L+1)):=by
      apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
      refine ⟨n+1,Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega),?_⟩
      simp only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]
    exact hp _ hmem ⟨hln,hh⟩
  have hd:=(@yui_aux_0037 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2.2 τ f hf n |>.2
  have hs:=(@yui_aux_0044 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2 τ f hfs n |>.2
  have hreg:=(@yui_aux_0071 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2.2 τ hτ n _ hd hs
  have hsm:=(@yui_aux_0074 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2 _ hreg l r hlr
  apply (@yui_aux_0075 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2 _ _ _ _ hsm
  intro t ht
  exact heq n t ⟨hnl.trans ht.1,ht.2.trans hrn⟩)
